title: Read-only gate refuses `git branch -r --contains <commit>`, a listing filter, as if it named or changed a branch
outcome: Read-only gate refuses `git branch -r --contains <commit>`, a listing filter, as if it named or changed a branch
acceptance: The read-only `git branch` rule (file:line) admits listing filters that take a commit argument (`--contains`, `--no-contains`, `--merged`, `--no-merged`, `--points-at`) together with listing options such as `-a`/`-r`/`-v`/`--list`, consuming the commit argument so it is not mistaken for a branch name.

Regressions: `git branch -r --contains <sha>` and `git branch -a --merged <sha>` are admitted; `git branch <name>`, `git branch -d <name>`, `git branch -m …`, `git branch -f …`, `--set-upstream-to` and `--edit-description` stay refused.
